notes.title: Update [v1.0.2.3]
notes.notes:
[h2]🎰 Hey Gamblers,[/h2]

[h3]♠️ We’re excited to share some new updates with you! Additionally, we’ve launched our Discord server to hear your suggestions and feedback directly. We’d love for you to join us there![/h3]

[h2]🔥 What's new:[/h2]

[h3][list]

[*] Online Casino tables!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45048174/1e3de9525ff5054491a7696a029eccb65b004905.gif[/img]
[*] Second floor!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45048174/82c1f10bc857e868e9919a3204f5d97bb4b00560.gif[/img]
[/list][/h3]

[h2]🔥 Bug fixes:[/h2]

[h3][list]
[*] Customer AI has been significantly improved! Now, your customers won’t leave the casino immediately. They can enjoy multiple activities, such as playing blackjack, trying their luck at roulette, or even heading to the bar.
[*] Bugs in the decoration system have been fixed.
[*] Time now progresses more slowly.
[*] The clock only starts ticking when your casino is open.
[*] An issue where lights sometimes wouldn’t save has been resolved.
[*] Localization fixes
[*] UI fixes
[*] Visual fixes
[/list][/h3]

[h3]🎲 Stay tuned! More updates are on the way![/h3]

notes.title: Update [v1.0.2.2]
notes.notes:
[h2]🎰 Hey Gamblers,[/h2]

[h3]♠️ We know we've kept you waiting for the update and we're sorry for that. We are constantly testing to make sure you don't encounter any bugs. That's why update times can be a bit longer. But you can be sure that we will bring faster updates from now on.[/h3]

[h2]🔥 What's new:[/h2]

[h3][list]

[*] Pole dance!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45048174/25c7e2faabb4f1e6286797b6222d335743de9b2b.gif[/img]
[*] Ability to buy an extra poker chips cashier!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45048174/121aa9c0a2e7a8364c088da78d3b05b06905b53e.gif[/img]
[*] Ability to buy an extra cash cashier!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45048174/48faffc14b1f51b9f1e4391d90a6be073dfcc0e4.gif[/img]
[*] New decorations!

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45048174/84cea3d4b40a80efc65c836d63f870fe8ab94fdf.jpg[/img]
[*] New floor decorations.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45048174/7bdba2d7ce1edac8f388fd911ca56a11b43818b9.png[/img]
[*] New wall decorations.

[img]https://clan.fastly.steamstatic.com/images/45048174/45056bdb1a0e23ec58f2a54477fb76e802499e10.png[/img]
[/list][/h3]

[h2]🔥 Bug fixes:[/h2]

[h3][list]
[*] You will have more customers because you complained that you had few customers.
[*] Fixed the issue of not being able to move to the next day due to capacity being at - or + at the end of the day.
[*] Removed the warning for repeat customers.
[*] Security is more functional now. They can detect cheaters more quickly.
[*] Fixed the problem of sometimes not ending the day with the ENTER key.
[*] Fixed the issue where boxes you purchased would fall into the sea.
[*] Localization fixes
[*] UI fixes
[*] Visual fixes
[/list][/h3]

[h2]🔥 What's next?[/h2]

[h3][list]
[*] Ability to play casino games ourselves (Blackjack, roulette, etc.)
[*] Add online casino tables to your casino.
[*] More casino machines and tables.
[*] A new and big city in the continuation of your island!
[*] Ability to buy and drive a car.
[*] Buying a house or apartment.
[*] More advanced customer AI.
[*] More employees.
[/list][/h3]

[h3]🎲 Thank you very much for supporting us. And please don't worry, we are committed to keep updating our game and make it the best casino simulation game.[/h3]

[h3]♥️ Please don't forget to share any suggestions you would like to see in the game![/h3]
